# Technical Design Template

## Context

Describe the requirement, current architecture, and constraints.

## Goals

List what the design must accomplish.

## Non-goals

List what the design will not solve.

## Design

Describe components, boundaries, data flow, and interfaces.

## Validation

Describe tests, type checks, OpenSpec validation, and manual checks.

## Risks

List risks and mitigations.

## Rollback

Describe how to undo the change.
